Records: 6 new base (CPI New Bern; FTI Pittsboro, Opelika, Monroe; Schneider Mount Juliet; Schneider El Paso campus) and 5 new excluded (Eaton Bellevue, Eaton Henrico, MMR Lafayette, Schneider Smyrna, Siemens Fort Worth). Schneider careers jobs API (careers.se.com/api/jobs) is readable with tools/fetch_page.py although the careers.se.com/jobs pages are Akamai-blocked: Mount Juliet posts Fabrication Technicians who weld metal; El Paso posts a Fabrication Associate I - Welder (description is automated-cell operation; low confidence); Smyrna searches return only Mount Juliet postings. Pre-production conflict: run-log rule 6 keeps pre-production plants as base, while the delegation says large switchgear plants with no site-level welding are out; the delegation was applied to Eaton Bellevue and Eaton Henrico (excluded, pre-production noted) and rule 6 to FTI Monroe (base, prospect_test unknown; DC-MV1 excluded the operating FTI Excellerate Little Chute site because it shows no welding, while FTI Pittsboro and Opelika post pipe-fitter/welder roles). FTI Pittsboro and Opelika rest on pipe-spool welding with skids and pipe racks as secondary work (coordinator to rule). Leads not recorded: FTI El Paso TX and Olathe KS manufacturing sites (pipefitter/welder postings); IEM Fremont FRE1 (OSHA 2966708, 376, 335313); Nucor Data Systems Madison IN (OSHA 2906308) and Frankfort KY (OSHA 2910213); Roeslein Modular Fabrication Red Bud IL (OSHA 3275517, 125); GO Industries (Longhorn Reels) fabrication plants in Richardson and Clifton TX; S&S Technical, 5130 Piney Grove Rd, Cumming GA (EPA ECHO) data-center pump skids, welding not stated (unverified); Schneider El Paso Plants 2, 3, 5 and Annex (EPA ECHO).
